title: Originals: Last Backflip
description: Crouch, tuck backward, extend, then lose balance into a loose landing

title: Originals: Final Meditation
description: Sit cross-legged and dissolve peacefully

title: Originals: Rubber Band
description: Stretch under tension, snap back through diminishing elastic rebounds, then settle into an interactive connected physics ragdoll

title: Originals: Balloon Farewell
description: A balloon lifts the player by one arm, then the player, balloon and string fade away together

title: Originals: Twister
description: Wind catches the body, limbs trail the spiral, then it is flung out and lands as an interactive connected physics ragdoll

title: Originals: Ban Hammer
description: A giant BAN hammer winds back, swings onto the player with a metallic slam, and rebounds as BANNED flashes above an interactive connected physics ragdoll

title: Originals: Whirlpool
description: A fixed water funnel draws the body through an accelerating inward and downward spiral before it fades at the center.

title: Originals: Final Bloom
description: The player falls forward and lies flat; a pink tulip then grows from the chest of the resting body

title: Originals: Between Stones
description: Two slabs squeeze the player from both sides

title: Originals: Card Trick
description: An ornate Ace of Hearts rises, takes the player behind its face, flips to its patterned back, then sails away

title: Originals: Signal Lost
description: Severe lag freezes the body, snaps it between positions and rubber-bands it back through bright scanline glitches

title: Originals: Music Box
description: Dance on a music box while a delicate chiming melody plays and softly winds down

title: PAC-MAN: Last Bite
description: An eyeless, pure yellow PAC-MAN opens and closes his round pixel mouth, eats the pellets and consumes the player in three timed bites

title: Among Us: Ejected
description: The player tumbles sideways out of an airlock while the familiar not-the-Impostor verdict appears.

title: The Ring: Cursed Tape
description: Sadako crawls through the front of a deep, closed CRT television, emerges head and hands first, then drags the player back through its screen; hidden skin sections never protrude through the rear

title: Originals: Bowling Split
description: A short, accelerating roll sends a regulation-size ball through a triangular ten-pin rack. Each pin tips and transfers momentum through individual contacts; the scatter then drives the player backward into a connected ragdoll, ending on the lane with an arcade strike callout.

title: Originals: Domino Bridge Collapse
description: Nine oversized dotted dominoes tip one by one when each falling edge reaches the next; the final heavy tile crushes the player and settles flat over the wreckage.

title: Originals: Claw Machine Prize Drop
description: An internal rail-mounted claw lowers into a plush-filled cabinet, grips the seated player, lifts clear of the prizes and carries them above an open internal chute. The player drops into the lower prize compartment and briefly peeks up before settling inside.

title: Pac-Man: Ghost Pinch
description: A short maze corridor appears; Blinky and Inky close from opposite ends, Pac-Man's remaining dot counter hits zero, and the victim becomes a brief yellow maze-shaped sparkle.

title: Originals: Paper Airplane Fold
description: The player becomes a skin-printed upright sheet. It closes and reopens a center crease, folds both top corners and angled edges inward, closes the center, forms two wings, pulls backward and flies 96 blocks into a gradual fade.

title: Originals: Photocopier Mass Production
description: An open office copier receives the player flat on its scanner glass. A bright bar completes a scan before sequential skin-printed pages feed through the recessed front slot and flutter onto the floor.

title: Originals: Washing Machine Spin Cycle
description: A closed front-loader opens its hinged glass door for suction. The player enters through the front, tumbles inside the enclosed spinning barrel, then exits through the reopened front door with an upward boost, ragdoll landing and clean sparkles.

title: Originals: Paper Shredder Strip
description: The victim becomes one floating white page printed with their actual skin. The page turns head-first into the top slot, feeds down continuously and emerges below as flexible skin-printed paper strips. The ribbons curl, detach and settle into a scattered pile on the normal ground.

title: Originals: Player Deflate
description: The player briefly inflates, then loses pressure torso-first. Wrinkled skin, outer layers and worn armor sag together as the knees buckle, leaving a recognizable, motionless 3D inflatable shell.

title: Originals: Shell Game Vanish
description: Five increasingly fast shuffle stages hide the player completely. Left-click a cup: only the tracked winning cup reveals the player and wins; a wrong cup opens empty before the true prize is revealed.

title: Originals: Nested Doll Close
description: Each death chooses one matryoshka scene: six larger painted shells close around a full-size player, or twelve dolls open to reveal exact half-size copies of the player.

title: Originals: Carpet Roll-Up
description: The rug's striped edge curls into a rotating roll, takes the player sideways through a full turn and carries the hidden body off the far end.

title: Originals: Calendar Page Age-Out
description: A floating calendar counts from day one to 999,999,999 as the player slowly grays, grows a long white beard and hunches. The elderly player then transforms into a vanilla skeleton that collapses and dissolves into ash.

title: Among Us: Impostor Kill
description: A red Impostor strikes with a quick cartoon blood spray; the lower crewmate body and exposed bone drop together, tip onto the floor and remain as the classic Among Us corpse.
